  html:

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 780

# ── Dependências ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ── Dados (servidos estaticamente junto ao HTML) ──────────────────────────────
df <- tryCatch({
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
  download.file("data/capacity_summary.csv", tmp, quiet = TRUE)
  read.csv(tmp, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Aviso: ", conditionMessage(e))
  data.frame(
    K=integer(), C=integer(), scenario=character(), policy=character(),
    mean_h1=double(), mean_h2=double(), mean_risk=double(),
    frames_per_drone=double(), channel_util=double()
  )
})

# ── Paleta e constantes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
POL_COLORS <- c(
  "round-robin"      = "#378ADD",
  "pf-classic"       = "#D85A30",
  "aoi-pure"         = "#1D9E75",
  "aoi-normalized"   = "#2DC4A0",
  "risk-aware"       = "#7F77DD",
  "max-weight-drift" = "#F4A261"
)
DARK_BG  <- "#1e1e2e"
PANEL_BG <- "#13131f"
GRID_COL <- "#2a2a4a"
TEXT_COL <- "#cdd6f4"
AXIS_COL <- "#a6adc8"

k_vals  <- sort(unique(df$K))
pol_all <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(df$policy))

# ── Tema ggplot2 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theme_dark_uam <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = DARK_BG,  color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = PANEL_BG, color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = GRID_COL, linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text             = element_text(color = TEXT_COL),
    axis.text        = element_text(color = AXIS_COL, size = 8),
    axis.title       = element_text(color = TEXT_COL, size = 9),
    plot.title       = element_text(color = TEXT_COL, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.background= element_rect(fill = DARK_BG, color = NA),
    legend.key       = element_blank(),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 8, color = TEXT_COL),
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = margin(6, 8, 6, 8)
  )
}

# ── Gráfico: C × métrica, uma linha por política ──────────────────────────────
make_plot <- function(d, y_col, y_label, colors) {
  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = .5, y = .5, label = "Sem dados",
                 color = AXIS_COL, size = 4) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = DARK_BG, color = NA))
    )
  }
  agg <- d |>
    group_by(C, policy) |>
    summarise(y = mean(.data[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(agg, aes(x = C, y = y, color = policy, group = policy)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, shape = 16) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 100, by = 10)) +
    labs(x = "Capacidade C", y = y_label, title = y_label) +
    theme_dark_uam()
}

# ── Módulo: sidebar de filtros + 5 gráficos ───────────────────────────────────
tab_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  fluidRow(
    column(2,
      style = paste0("background:", DARK_BG, "; padding:12px; border-radius:6px;"),
      tags$h6("K (drones/slot)", style = paste0("color:", TEXT_COL, ";")),
      checkboxGroupInput(ns("k_sel"), NULL,
        choices  = as.character(k_vals),
        selected = as.character(k_vals)
      ),
      tags$hr(style = paste0("border-color:", GRID_COL, ";")),
      tags$h6("Políticas", style = paste0("color:", TEXT_COL, ";")),
      checkboxGroupInput(ns("pol_sel"), NULL,
        choices  = pol_all,
        selected = pol_all
      ),
      tags$br(),
      actionButton(ns("sel_all"),  "Selec. todas",
        class = "btn-sm btn-outline-secondary", width = "100%"),
      tags$br(), tags$br(),
      actionButton(ns("sel_none"), "Limpar",
        class = "btn-sm btn-outline-secondary", width = "100%")
    ),
    column(10,
      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotOutput(ns("p_h1"),     height = "240px")),
        column(6, plotOutput(ns("p_risk"),   height = "240px"))
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotOutput(ns("p_frames"), height = "240px")),
        column(6, plotOutput(ns("p_util"),   height = "240px"))
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(12, plotOutput(ns("p_h2"),    height = "240px"))
      )
    )
  )
}

tab_server <- function(id, sc_id) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {

    observeEvent(input$sel_all, {
      updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "pol_sel", selected = pol_all)
    })
    observeEvent(input$sel_none, {
      updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "pol_sel", selected = character(0))
    })

    filt <- reactive({
      req(length(input$k_sel) > 0)
      df |>
        filter(
          scenario == sc_id,
          K        %in% as.integer(input$k_sel),
          policy   %in% input$pol_sel
        )
    })

    colors_active <- reactive({
      POL_COLORS[names(POL_COLORS) %in% input$pol_sel]
    })

    output$p_h1     <- renderPlot({
      make_plot(filt(), "mean_h1",          "AoI médio h₁ (slots)",       colors_active())
    }, bg = DARK_BG)
    output$p_risk   <- renderPlot({
      make_plot(filt(), "mean_risk",        "Risco médio total",                colors_active())
    }, bg = DARK_BG)
    output$p_frames <- renderPlot({
      make_plot(filt(), "frames_per_drone", "Frames entregues por drone",       colors_active())
    }, bg = DARK_BG)
    output$p_util   <- renderPlot({
      make_plot(filt(), "channel_util",     "Utilização canal vídeo [0–1]", colors_active())
    }, bg = DARK_BG)
    output$p_h2     <- renderPlot({
      make_plot(filt(), "mean_h2",          "AoI médio h₂ (slots)",       colors_active())
    }, bg = DARK_BG)
  })
}

# ── UI global ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
css_extra <- paste0("
  body { background:", DARK_BG, "; }
  .nav-tabs .nav-link        { color:", AXIS_COL, "; }
  .nav-tabs .nav-link.active { color:", TEXT_COL, "; background:", PANEL_BG, "; }
  .shiny-input-container     { color:", TEXT_COL, "; }
  h6 { margin-bottom:5px; font-size:0.75rem; letter-spacing:.06em;
       text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:600; }
  label { color:", AXIS_COL, " !important; font-size:0.82rem; }
")

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(bootswatch = "darkly"),
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML(css_extra))),
  tags$div(style = "padding: 10px 8px 0 8px;",
    tags$h4("⚿ UAM Capacity · Lite Dashboard",
            style = paste0("color:", TEXT_COL, "; margin-bottom:2px;")),
    tags$p(
      style = paste0("color:", AXIS_COL, "; font-size:0.82rem; margin-bottom:8px;"),
      paste0("Corredor 2 km · steady 20 min · ",
             nrow(df), " runs carregados")
    )
  ),
  tabsetPanel(id = "main_tabs",
    tabPanel("A* · 1 rota",       tab_ui("astar1")),
    tabPanel("A* · 2 rotas",      tab_ui("astar2")),
    tabPanel("Static · 1 rota",   tab_ui("static1")),
    tabPanel("Static · 2 rotas",  tab_ui("static2"))
  )
)

# ── Server global ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  tab_server("astar1",  "1r_astar")
  tab_server("astar2",  "2r_astar")
  tab_server("static1", "1r_static")
  tab_server("static2", "2r_static")
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
